title: Antillia Platform
value: Helps overseas buyers compare Caribbean properties and organize due diligence.
evidence: The current company landing page links directly to antillia.online; the destination serves property discovery and evidence-confidence content.
gap: Individual listing provenance, advisor credentials, lead delivery and vault permissions were not verified.
acceptance: Trace one published listing to source documents, route a test inquiry and confirm private documents cannot be read by another user.
commercial: Broker-led onboarding and property intelligence subscription.

title: Infrastructure PMIS
value: Gives lenders and project teams a shared view of budgets, milestones and disbursements.
evidence: The published app redirects to pmisforbanks.com. The browser remained on Loading during the initial inspection; its public bundle was retrieved.
gap: A reachable site does not establish working project updates, approvals or portfolio reconciliation.
acceptance: Create a sandbox project, submit an approved variation and reconcile a staged disbursement to the ledger.
commercial: Paid discovery followed by one institution pilot.

title: FaMaaS - Fixed Assets Management
value: Reduces manual asset-register work and depreciation preparation.
evidence: Browser test completed the IFRS demo setup and opened a dashboard with 26 sample assets and depreciation navigation.
gap: Marketing customer counts, uptime and 100% compliance claims were not independently evidenced; tenant isolation and accounting results remain untested.
acceptance: Reconcile five asset examples including disposal and impairment to independently prepared schedules; prove company isolation.
commercial: Prioritize a controlled accountant-led pilot.

title: BetterBooks Caribbean for QuickBooks
value: Connects Caribbean POS, payroll and VAT work to bookkeeping.
evidence: The Better Books Caribbean destination and its public bundle are reachable. Bundle text includes posted-versus-simulated reconciliation and OAuth configuration screens.
gap: Successful token refresh, duplicate prevention and real QuickBooks posting have not been demonstrated.
acceptance: Post a sandbox sale twice, verify one receipt only, expire the token and reconcile posting totals.
commercial: Sell implementation plus support after connector acceptance.

title: IFRS & GAAP AI Statement Generator
value: Provides a structured trial-balance-to-reporting and audit workpaper workflow.
evidence: Browser opened Enterprise Financial Framework Studio, explicitly labelled Single-Tenant / Local. It shows mapping, materiality and completion gates; the initial TB was out of balance and sign-off gates flagged it.
gap: Local administrator UI is not server authentication. Final statements, imports, export accuracy and shared storage were not validated.
acceptance: Import a balanced synthetic TB, map every account, reconcile all statements and prove sign-off remains blocked for an unbalanced TB.
commercial: Offer a reviewed local reporting tool before promising hosted multi-user SaaS.

title: EcoChill Proposa-Link
value: Helps businesses compare refrigeration and microgrid investment proposals.
evidence: Public rendered interface contains asset sizing, a 10-year IRR matrix, entity/currency selection and a proposal approval queue.
gap: Displayed returns and staged PostgreSQL operations do not prove actual savings or durable approval records.
acceptance: Recalculate NPV and IRR from exported cash flows and verify an approval survives a new session.
commercial: Paid energy assessment with an editable proposal model.

title: Belize Blue Economy MRV MIS
value: Organizes blue-economy indicators, investment inventory and evidence verification.
evidence: Rendered overview includes verification queue, CSV/PDF controls and programme components; initial contributor and capital totals are zero.
gap: Zero totals do not establish a populated government system; evidence provenance and contributor permissions are untested.
acceptance: Submit synthetic field evidence, reject then approve it, and reconcile the indicator and CSV changes.
commercial: Commissioned M&E pilot with a named programme owner.

title: Caribbean Finance Hub
value: Helps micro-lenders reconcile loan books and monitor arrears.
evidence: Current destination is a micro-lending risk engine with ledger input, aging, underwriting, tax bridge and TB import; initial public view contains zero balances.
gap: Zero/default data and visible role choices do not establish server-enforced permissions or valid lending calculations.
acceptance: Run a synthetic amortization schedule through payment, partial arrears and write-off; reconcile interest and aging.
commercial: One lender pilot after reconciliation acceptance.

title: Easy Sales Cloud
value: Supports retail sales and inventory workflows.
evidence: Destination is branded JACS Financials — AI Point of Sale; public bundle contains authentication and role-handling code.
gap: Inventory consistency, offline sync and QuickBooks receipt posting were not verified.
acceptance: Complete a sale, return and duplicate webhook in a sandbox and reconcile stock, cash and journals.
commercial: Implementation-led retail pilot.

title: VAT Reporter AI
value: Helps accountants prepare and review VAT working papers.
evidence: Destination and public bundle are reachable; bundle contains an explicit QuickBooks-not-connected path and sample-data wording.
gap: Current country rules, imported input VAT and filing outputs were not tested.
acceptance: Reconcile a synthetic return with standard, exempt, credit-note and imported-input transactions against independently checked rules.
commercial: Accountant-assisted preparation service; validate each jurisdiction before a filing claim.

title: Gender and Climate Finance Tagging Platform
value: Structures climate-finance tagging, project evidence and reporting.
evidence: Published route redirects to gcftportal.org. Public repository contains React pages, server routers and database schema; README identifies a full-stack deployment.
gap: Repository breadth does not prove active integrations, independently verified credits or government acceptance.
acceptance: Trace one tagged transaction to evidence, approval, exported report and server audit event using isolated tenants.
commercial: Institutional evidence-management pilot.

title: Dominica DOMCREP M&E MIS
value: Tracks resilience-programme activities, outputs and evidence.
evidence: DOMCREP-branded destination and its application bundle are reachable.
gap: Programme authorization, live records and indicator calculations were not verified.
acceptance: Create a synthetic result, attach evidence, exercise reviewer approval and verify export totals.
commercial: Programme-specific implementation and support.

title: Grenada UBEC Blue Economy M&E
value: Gives a blue-economy programme a consistent monitoring workspace.
evidence: Grenada UBEC-branded destination and public bundle are reachable.
gap: Source data, role enforcement, programme authorization and reporting acceptance remain unverified.
acceptance: Reconcile an indicator from baseline to approved result and test another organization cannot read it.
commercial: Institutional pilot after indicator design review.

title: OECS AI Institute Platform
value: Introduces training and incubator services and helps recruit participants.
evidence: The Institute website is reachable and identifies virtual incubation and AI education.
gap: A public website does not verify a working LMS, mentorship matching or learner progress records.
acceptance: Enroll a sandbox learner, complete a module and prove progress persists with appropriate access.
commercial: Market training and incubation; demonstrate LMS separately.

title: Close Command Hub
value: Helps finance teams reconcile subscription flows and document close exceptions.
evidence: Rendered page is a specialized SaaS Close Command Deck with Stripe flows, refund demonstration, deferred revenue and QBO export tabs.
gap: The specialized reconciliation deck does not substantiate the broader advertised close-management suite or live Stripe sync.
acceptance: Reconcile a synthetic annual subscription, fee, refund and month-end recognition through balanced journals.
commercial: Productize the narrow reconciliation workflow first.

title: Executive Portfolio Hub
value: Consolidates management views across personal and business entities.
evidence: Rendered Meridian dashboard includes multiple entities, ledger rows and balance-sheet summaries.
gap: Displayed portfolio values are interface content, not independently confirmed assets; data feeds and consolidation eliminations were not tested.
acceptance: Import a synthetic intercompany transaction and verify consolidated elimination and source-to-report reconciliation.
commercial: Private reporting engagement with controlled data access.

title: QuickBooks Utility Tools
value: Helps accountants review duplicate accounts and prepare bulk cleanup actions.
evidence: Browser loaded 25 sample accounts. Find duplicates displayed a dry-run preview with 14 steps, including a rejected merge.
gap: Live Desktop bridge, Online OAuth, rollback and actual accounting mutations were not tested. Absolute reversibility and all-error validation claims need evidence.
acceptance: Use a disposable QuickBooks company to test preview, merge dependencies, export, backup and recovery.
commercial: Prioritize a supervised beta with backups and an accountant review step.

title: JACS Restaurant Management
value: Coordinates restaurant ordering, kitchen activity and POS operations.
evidence: Current destination is JAMROCK Restaurant POS; its bundle contains staff PIN/session handling and application workflows.
gap: Payment, kitchen delivery, QR ordering and accounting synchronization were not verified end to end.
acceptance: Place one test QR order, confirm kitchen delivery, void it and reconcile the receipt and stock movement.
commercial: One restaurant pilot with a defined support contract.

title: E-Testing Driver's License
value: Supports digitized driver-theory testing administration.
evidence: OECS E-Testing destination and bundle are reachable; public bundle includes local storage and demo booking paths.
gap: Official exam approval, identity checks, question security and tamper-resistant result storage were not demonstrated.
acceptance: Exercise candidate-to-result workflow with synthetic identities and prove a candidate cannot alter score or access another result.
commercial: Government pilot after identity and examination acceptance.

title: eLandSaintLucia
value: Could simplify parcel searches and land-record discovery.
evidence: The configured eLand destination returned HTTP 403 during the automated check.
gap: Access-blocked is not proof of a missing application; source records, title verification and blockchain/LADM claims cannot be evaluated here.
acceptance: Provide an authorized test environment, verify a parcel against source records and demonstrate role-based edits and history.
commercial: Keep as access-restricted and arrange a controlled demonstration.

title: JACS Hospice Management Platform
value: Could reduce duplicated hospice scheduling and care documentation.
evidence: JACS Medical destination and bundle are reachable; bundle contains clinical workflow and demo-seeding paths. No patient records were inspected.
gap: Clinical controls, production data protection, tenancy, backups and operational suitability were not verified.
acceptance: Use synthetic patients to test care-plan permissions, corrections, exports and recovery with the clinical operator.
commercial: Institution-led evaluation with synthetic data before live use.

title: BetterBooks Caribbean Marketing Page
value: Explains BetterBooks services and supports lead generation.
evidence: A separate BetterBooks marketing destination and bundle are reachable.
gap: This is a marketing page, not another accounting engine. Conversion claims and form delivery remain untested.
acceptance: Submit an agreed synthetic lead and confirm delivery and owner assignment.
commercial: Treat as a sales channel for BetterBooks, not a separate SaaS product.

title: TV & Radio Financial Management System
value: Could organize advertising revenue, campaign costs and proof-of-play records.
evidence: Original company path does not identify the application; current company portfolio config has no real app URL.
gap: No matching application source or functioning destination was established.
acceptance: Supply the source and demo; reconcile an insertion order to spots delivered, invoice and cash collection.
commercial: Demo on request until the application is recovered.

title: MLS Real Estate Marketplace
value: Could centralize property and other asset discovery across the OECS.
evidence: Custom-domain destination serves OECS Marketplace. Its public bundle is byte-identical to the OECS Realtors destination.
gap: This appears to be a deployment alias rather than evidence of a separate MLS product; broker data rights and lead routing remain untested.
acceptance: Trace an authorized listing through search, update, inquiry routing and broker permissions.
commercial: Consolidate marketplace positioning and confirm listing rights.

title: OECS Realtors Platform
value: Connects buyers and sellers of Caribbean properties and other assets.
evidence: Lovable destination serves the same title and identical public bundle as the MLS custom-domain deployment.
gap: Do not count this alias as independently delivered SaaS functionality; actual listing and lead operations remain unverified.
acceptance: Verify listing ownership, moderation, seller contact and stale-listing handling.
commercial: Use one canonical marketplace and one operating offer.

title: Wheels Works Auto Shop
value: Demonstrates service booking and vehicle-business operations.
evidence: The live Wheels Works destination is branded Smiley Tinting Plus and explicitly labels payment and QuickBooks synchronization as simulated.
gap: Title/positioning differs from a general auto-shop system; live payments, booking concurrency and accounting were not tested.
acceptance: Race two bookings for the same slot and test a sandbox deposit, refund and accounting reconciliation.
commercial: Offer a tinting-business demo; validate a pilot before broad auto-shop claims.

title: OECS Trading Platform
value: Introduces trading, advisory services and the software portfolio.
evidence: The company website and portfolio were inspected; it routes visitors to applications and contact channels.
gap: This is a company website, not evidence of a transactional logistics platform.
acceptance: Trace a trade inquiry to a named owner and demonstrate any claimed shipment/order workflow separately.
commercial: Use as the corporate sales channel.

title: Smiley's Tinting Plus — Business & Inspection Hub
value: Shows how a tinting business could coordinate inspections, proposals and accounting views.
evidence: Matching GitHub Pages source is Smiley’s Business Hub v12. Source includes simulated Stripe webhook events and client-side payment-link actions.
gap: Sample operations do not establish persistent bookings, AI damage assessment or real payment processing.
acceptance: Complete an inspection-to-proposal-to-deposit flow in a sandbox and verify persistence and image handling.
commercial: Controlled service-business demonstration.

title: Audit Studio — AI-Powered Audit Platform
value: Gives small audit firms a structured engagement and workpaper workspace.
evidence: Matching Complete Platform source uses browser localStorage; its FAQ explicitly says cross-device collaboration needs the Phase 2 backend. DeepSeek calls require a configured proxy.
gap: Default demo credentials, browser-side roles and a local hash chain are not hosted identity or an independently immutable audit trail.
acceptance: Import a synthetic TB, review a workpaper, verify export and restore; separately test backend identity and AI proxy failure.
commercial: Prioritize a single-workstation pilot, then build shared-service controls.

title: Caribbean Gas Intelligence — dMRV Monitoring System
value: Explains gas monitoring and replenishment workflows to operators and investors.
evidence: Matching GitHub Pages document contains a platform/user-guide demonstration. Source has no fetch calls and depicts simulated monitoring/order flows.
gap: No evidence of live sensor ingestion, emergency alarms, payments or dispatched orders was established.
acceptance: Replay signed sensor readings through alert, operator acknowledgement and a sandbox replenishment event.
commercial: Sell feasibility and integration work before a monitoring subscription.

title: Antillia Skills Bank — Verified Professionals
value: Demonstrates talent discovery, filtering and profile presentation.
evidence: Matching source explicitly declares eight demo workers but displays verified-worker claims and a much larger headline count.
gap: Background checks, credential verification, actual worker availability and real client ratings were not evidenced.
acceptance: Use consented test profiles; verify credentials against source documents and distinguish pending from verified.
commercial: Recruit a documented pilot cohort before marketplace launch.

title: Biogas St. Lucia — Northern Pilot (Gros Islet)
value: Communicates a proposed northern Saint Lucia digester and filling-station design.
evidence: Matching source contains engineering tabs and fixed commercial-scale payback/IRR values. It describes a 6 m³ pilot and larger-scale economics.
gap: Fixed displayed figures are scenarios, not operating returns or a validated financial engine; pilot and commercial-scale results must remain separate.
acceptance: Rebuild cash flows with feedstock, uptime, upgrading, compression, delivery and maintenance assumptions, then independently recalculate returns.
commercial: Engineering feasibility and investor discussion document.

title: Biogas St. Lucia — Vieux Fort Pilot
value: Could communicate a separate Vieux Fort pilot design and budget.
evidence: The advertised local HTML is absent. The recovered northern-pilot source mentions Vieux Fort comparisons but is not the specified Vieux Fort application.
gap: An exact matching source was not established; quoted CAPEX and returns cannot be checked as an app.
acceptance: Recover the exact design and reconcile mass/energy balance, BoQ and cash-flow assumptions.
commercial: Keep as demo on request rather than substituting the northern pilot.

title: COSMOS Biogas Haiti — Filling Station Pilot
value: Explains a proposed Haitian biogas filling station and equipment scope.
evidence: Matching GitHub Pages source is COSMOS Biogas Filling Station — Engineering Design Package, with equipment, cost and climate sections.
gap: A design document does not demonstrate installed plant, sales, registry issuance or measured emissions.
acceptance: Validate supplier quotes, gas quality assumptions, plant uptime and cash flows against the engineering design.
commercial: Commissioned feasibility and procurement planning.

title: Biogas Haiti — Industrial Division (1,000 m³)
value: Could present the economics and rollout of a larger Haitian digester.
evidence: No exact standalone 1,000 m³ industrial-division source was established. The recovered filling-station package has an integration reference only.
gap: A related engineering reference cannot establish the advertised industrial app or its claimed return figures.
acceptance: Recover the industrial model, reconcile annual production and operating costs, and calculate NPV/IRR from explicit cash flows.
commercial: Keep exact product unavailable; identify related material separately.

title: BiogasSTLucia — GCF/CDB Concept Note
value: Supports development of a climate-finance concept note.
evidence: An exact 18-section GCF/CDB concept-note file was not established. A related BiogasSTLucia master proposal exists and includes sensor simulation.
gap: Related proposal material is not the advertised exact grant document and does not evidence funding approval.
acceptance: Recover the exact submission; reconcile budget, financing sources, results framework and supporting evidence.
commercial: Proposal-development service; demo on request for this edition.

title: Rivet & Roan Barber Co. — Booking Platform
value: Could automate barber appointment availability and reduce no-shows.
evidence: Advertised local booking HTML is absent and no matching repository was established.
gap: Slot locking, deposits, reminders and waitlist automation cannot be verified.
acceptance: Recover source, attempt simultaneous bookings and verify sandbox deposit/refund and reminder delivery.
commercial: Keep off the launch path pending recovery.

title: CaribCarbon — Caribbean Climate Asset Marketplace
value: Could help project developers compare climate-asset opportunities.
evidence: The exact CaribCarbon app was not found. An older OECS carbon marketplace repository is related material, not a confirmed match.
gap: Country parameters, revenue share, registry integration and tradable assets are unverified.
acceptance: Recover exact source and reconcile each calculator; trace a project to independent validation and registry records.
commercial: Demonstration on request; do not imply issued credits or guaranteed income.

title: The AI AML/CFT Compliance Auditor — Standalone
value: Could organize AML/CFT controls, deficiencies and workpapers.
evidence: Advertised standalone AML/CFT HTML is absent; no exact matching source was established.
gap: Password gating and local attestations would not alone establish regulated access controls or compliance.
acceptance: Recover source and test import mapping, evidence retention, role isolation and reviewed report output using synthetic cases.
commercial: Recover and review before selling a compliance product.

title: Caribbean Micro-Lending Enterprise Matrix
value: Could support loan aging, underwriting and ledger reporting.
evidence: Exact standalone Enterprise Matrix HTML is absent. The recovered Caribbean Finance Hub is a related micro-lending risk-engine destination.
gap: Do not present a related version as the recovered standalone edition; exact calculations and RBAC remain unverified.
acceptance: Recover exact edition or formally consolidate with Finance Hub after a reconciled loan-book test.
commercial: Consolidate the product family; related demo only.

title: AI Financial Statement Generator — Audit Platform
value: Could turn a mapped trial balance into reviewed financial statements.
evidence: The company portfolio currently points this listing to the same Audit Studio URL as entry 29. An exact standalone generator source was not established.
gap: Duplicate destination is not evidence of a separate four-step generator or its PDF/Excel exports.
acceptance: Recover the exact module and reconcile position, performance, cash flow, notes and exports from a synthetic TB.
commercial: Position as a reporting module until separately demonstrated.

title: JACS Payroll — Caribbean-Compliant Payroll for QuickBooks
value: Helps Caribbean employers organize payroll, attendance and payslips.
evidence: The current OECS HR & Payroll destination opened an authenticated workspace with company selection and payroll navigation. No payroll was run and no private employee details are reproduced here.
gap: Nine-country statutory accuracy, cross-company isolation and live QuickBooks posting were not tested.
acceptance: Use a synthetic payroll in each supported country; independently verify deductions, approval, payslip and duplicate-safe sandbox posting.
commercial: Prioritize an accountant-led payroll pilot with versioned country rules.

title: Project Support for Dominica
value: Helps public-sector counterparts review a structured project-development approach.
evidence: Matching public source is an expression-of-interest and project-development support hub with phase tasks, results framework, risk matrix and browser-local progress. It explicitly describes the M&E/MRV systems as prototypes not yet deployed in any country.
gap: A proposal workspace does not demonstrate a commissioned institutional MIS or government adoption.
acceptance: Walk through one synthetic deliverable review, export the results framework and verify what progress persists across devices.
commercial: Offer project-development consulting with a supporting workspace.

title: Loyverse Bridge
review_level: Authenticated inventory interface inspected; no mutations
value: Could reduce duplicate work between restaurant inventory and accounting systems.
evidence: Browser opened the inventory workspace. It asks the user to connect Loyverse and import stores before adding inventory locations, and labels payroll and tables as sample modules.
gap: Multi-store stock consistency, recipe depletion, webhook idempotency and bookkeeping are not verified by a reachable route.
acceptance: Replay duplicate and out-of-order sale webhooks across two sandbox stores; reconcile recipe depletion, stock and balanced journal entries.
commercial: One restaurant integration pilot after inventory reconciliation acceptance.

title: Generative Legal Chambers
value: Demonstrates intake, draft preparation and legal-matter presentation.
evidence: Matching public source includes case and invoice views, templated draft generation and client-side actions. Attorney-review and LEDES-download buttons display alerts describing production behavior.
gap: An alert saying a draft was sent is not attorney delivery or e-filing. The source does not establish a working AI service, trust accounting or protected client workspace.
acceptance: Use a synthetic matter; trace document generation, counsel receipt, permissions and audit history without real filing or agreement execution.
commercial: Counsel-supervised prototype demonstration; implement protected matter workflows before operational use.

title: QuickBooks Desktop Bridge to QB Online
value: Could connect legacy QuickBooks POS Desktop sales to QuickBooks Online.
evidence: Browser landing page is specifically QB POS Desktop v19 to QBO, with agent, scheduled sync, OAuth and AI error-handling claims. It offers sign-in and a trial.
gap: This is narrower than a general QuickBooks Desktop migration bridge. Agent installation, token isolation, idempotency and accounting accuracy were not tested.
acceptance: In disposable POS/QBO companies, sync a sale and refund twice, refresh an expired token and reconcile item, tax and payment mappings.
commercial: Implementation-led migration/integration pilot; verify the actual source-product scope.

title: JACS Financial Management System with POS and QB Integration
review_level: Unauthenticated browser preview and catalogue navigation verified
value: Could combine POS operations and bookkeeping in one workflow.
evidence: An unauthenticated browser opened the JACS Financials PUBLIC PREVIEW. Overview, About, Products and Categories navigation are available. Browse product catalog opened the public catalogue; it displayed no matching products at the time of review. The page states that checkout, editing, deleting and syncing require sign-in.
gap: Public preview access is verified. The notice and visible controls do not prove backend authorization for every business action. Live POS transactions, inventory changes, QuickBooks posting and tenant isolation remain untested.
acceptance: Verify anonymous requests cannot mutate business records, then complete a synthetic sale, refund, inventory update and duplicate-safe QuickBooks sandbox posting under authorized test roles.
commercial: Public read-only demonstration is available; arrange an authorized operational pilot before production claims.
